intro: The NX Pro Digital Home Locker offers unmatched security with its motorized bolts, customizable digital lock, and flexible storage options. A modern, reliable guardian for your valuables.

features.title: Advanced motorized shooting bolts for unyielding security
features.text: These bolts are your security sentinels, locked until the correct password is entered—impervious to forceful attempts like magnets or shaking.

features.title: Digital locking mechanism for tailored protection
features.text: Set a 4-6 digit password for custom access. Effortless, personalized security designed to keep your treasures safe with every touch.

features.title: External USB charging support for convenience
features.text: Never run out of power! Charge your safe with the external USB port, ensuring you’re always ready for immediate use, no matter the situation.

features.title: Autolock keypad freeze function for extra protection
features.text: After four incorrect entries, the keypad locks down, keeping your valuables safe from unauthorized access and offering added peace of mind.

features.title: Emergency mechanical override for quick access
features.text: Low battery or forgotten password? No worries. The mechanical override ensures you’re never locked out, giving you quick and secure access.

features.title: Removable shelf for custom storage
features.text: Maximise space with the adjustable shelf, designed to hold taller items and organize your valuables with ease, offering flexibility whenever you need it.

name: Nx Pro 40 Litres Steel Digital Home Locker
